scenes.headline: Ransomware is hitting old NAS boxes
scenes.say: Got a Synology NAS at home or work? Ransomware is hitting the outdated ones.

scenes.headline: Patched in 2024. Still hit.
scenes.body: Synology, Oct 29: devices that never updated are being attacked.
scenes.say: On October twenty-ninth, Synology warned that attackers are exploiting a bug it patched back in December 2024, on devices that never updated.

scenes.headline: Synology NAS devices on the internet
scenes.body: Shadowserver count. Not all are vulnerable.
scenes.say: Shadowserver tracks over three hundred eighty thousand Synology devices exposed to the internet. Not all are vulnerable, but the outdated ones are targets.

scenes.headline: Files locked, ransom demanded
scenes.body: Files renamed .L0CK3D and a note asking for payment.
scenes.say: Victims find their files renamed with a locked extension, and a note demanding payment, reportedly thousands of dollars.

scenes.headline: RAID is not a backup.
scenes.body: If the NAS holds your only copy, ransomware takes it all. Keep one copy offline.
scenes.say: Analyst note: RAID is not a backup. If your NAS holds the only copy, ransomware takes it all. Keep one copy offline.

scenes.headline: Do this tonight
items: Block the admin page from the internet
scenes.say: Tonight: update DSM. Turn on automatic updates. And block the admin page from the internet.

scenes.headline: The security story behind the headline.
scenes.say: Sources are in the description. Follow Securidge.
